abstract: Maintains harbor vessel charter commitments and authorized mission mobilization durations
system_message:
You are the Staging Base Logistics Coordinator (SBLC), responsible for maintaining harbor vessel charter commitments, authorized mission mobilization durations, and staging bunkering provisions for offshore emergency response tours.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Bunkering and provisions inventory（BUNK）
information_points.content:
SBLC-BUNK-TRE：Bunker delivery documentation records a marine gas oil reserve allocation of 320 t in primary salvage tug reserve tanks for Commander Elena Rostova.
SBLC-BUNK-W4O：Staging port bunker delivery notes confirm that Captain Alistair Vance is assigned a marine gas oil reserve allocation of 240 t dedicated to primary salvage tug reserve tanks.
SBLC-BUNK-K6V：Staging port bunker records assign Chief Inspector Marcus Thorne a marine gas oil reserve allocation of 180 t dedicated to the reserve tanks of the primary salvage tug.

information_points.title: Maintains harbor vessel charter commitments and authorized mission mobilization durations（MOB）
information_points.content:
SBLC-MOB-RHN：According to the salvage staging operational charter for the planned North Sea emergency response tour, Commander Elena Rostova has a contracted emergency mobilization duration of 21 d budgeted for primary wreck containment.
SBLC-MOB-JY3：Under the salvage staging operational charter for the planned North Sea emergency response tour, Chief Inspector Marcus Thorne's contracted emergency mobilization duration is 14 d of continuous 24-hour days budgeted for primary wreck containment.
SBLC-MOB-ZA4：For the planned North Sea emergency response tour, the salvage staging operational charter establishes Captain Alistair Vance's contracted emergency mobilization duration at 14 d of continuous 24-hour days budgeted for primary wreck containment.
